lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arapee aap gavaaee chalaa satigur bhaae ||
lines.translation: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apune vitahu j har setee chit laae ||7||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so braahaman braham jo bi(n)de har setee ra(n)g raataa ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh nikat vasai sabhanaa ghat a(n)tar guramukh viralai jaataa ||
lines.translation: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||8||5||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahajai no sabh lochadee bin gur paaiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit jotakee thake bhekhee bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur bhete sahaj paaiaa aapanee kirapaa kare rajaai ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin sahaj na hoi ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai hee te sahaj oopajai har paaiaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje gaaviaa thaai pavai bin sahajai kathanee baad ||
lines.translation: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee bhagat oopajai sahaj piaar bairaag ||
lines.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahajai hee te sukh saat hoi bin sahajai jeevan baad ||2||
lines.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj saalaahee sadaa sadaa sahaj samaadh lagaai ||
lines.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee gun oocharai bhagat kare liv laai ||
lines.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabade hee har man vasai rasanaa har ras khaai ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje kaal vidaariaa sach saranaaee paai ||
lines.translation: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje har naam man vasiaa sachee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinee paaiaa sahaje rahe samaai ||4||
lines.translation: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa vich sahaj na oopajai maaiaa doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai jalai jalaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chookaee phir phir aavai jaai ||5||
lines.translation: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trihu gunaa vich sahaj na paaeeai trai gun bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paReeai guneeai kiaa katheeai jaa mu(n)dhahu ghuthaa jaai ||
lines.translation: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: chauthe pad mahi sahaj hai guramukh palai paai ||6||
lines.translation: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun naam nidhaan hai sahaje sojhee hoi ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bhuliaa sahaj milaaisee sabad milaavaa hoi ||7||
lines.translation: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sahajai sabh a(n)dh hai maaiaa mohu gubaar ||
lines.translation: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee sojhee paee sachai sabad apaar ||
lines.translation: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas milaaian poore gur karataar ||8||
lines.translation: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje adisat pachhaaneeai nirabhau jot nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik daataa jotee jot milaavanahaar ||
lines.translation: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad salaaheeai jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||9||
lines.translation: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sahaj karahi vaapaar ||
lines.translation: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin laahaa har naam lain akhut bhare bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tot na aavaee deee devanahaar ||10||6||23||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||
